functional_contract.available_state: Agent at room center with full list of visible receptacles from entry observation; target object not yet visible; inventory empty.
constraints: Must visit receptacles in the exact order presented in the initial room observation
Must open any closed receptacle before inspecting its contents
Must terminate search immediately upon successful target acquisition
functional_contract.local_function: Sequentially navigate to each receptacle in the listed order, open if closed, inspect contents, and take the target object when found.
functional_contract.required_downstream_state: Target object held in agent inventory; agent positioned at the receptacle where the target was found.

c_candidate.guidance: Navigate to the first available open cooking surface from the entry observation. Inspect it for the target object. If found, take it. If not found or if no such surface is reachable, fall back to visiting the next closed storage receptacle in the listed order, opening it if necessary, and inspecting its contents.
c_candidate.hypothesis: Prioritizing open cooking surfaces (e.g., stove burners) early in the sequential search, rather than strictly following the full listed order starting with closed storage receptacles, will locate the target cooking vessel faster while still satisfying the ordered-search contract when applied to the relevant subset of receptacles.

probe_spec.adaptive_policy: Select the first open cooking surface visible in the current observation. If the target is not present after navigation, select the next closed storage receptacle in the originally listed order. Open it if the observation indicates it is closed, then inspect. Take the target object immediately upon visual confirmation. Do not interact with non-target objects.
probe_spec.evidence_goal: Observation confirming the target cooking vessel is now in inventory, along with the number of receptacles visited compared to a strict full-list traversal.
probe_spec.local_function: Locate and acquire the target cooking vessel from a candidate receptacle.
probe_spec.realization_pattern: Navigate to an open cooking surface first; if unsuccessful, iterate through closed storage receptacles in listed order, opening each before inspection, until the target is found and taken.
probe_spec.required_downstream_state: Target cooking vessel held in agent inventory; agent positioned at the receptacle where the target was found, ready for the cooling phase.
stop_conditions: Target object successfully taken into inventory
All plausible cooking-related receptacles exhausted without finding the target
An action fails due to invalid state or missing capability
